```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

## Plan

-   Merge SNP table with Founder SNP table - save as RDS
-   Use haplotype inference using Maximum Likelihood method with a physical window size of 100,000 bp (lowest where error is flatish)
-   Parallelize via chromosome arm and sample

```{r}
#| eval: false

pool.snp <- readRDS(file = "/home/srikantv/Flying_Flies_Phenotyping/Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")

found.snp <- readRDS(file="/home/kingeg/Projects/MyGithub/HaplotypeEstimator/BigData/foundersnptable_convertedtoR6.rds")

merge.snp.table <- inner_join(pool.snp, found.snp, by = join_by(CHROM, POS))

#drop any alleles that dont match
ww <- which(merge.snp.table$ALT.x != merge.snp.table$ALT.y)
merge.snp.table <- merge.snp.table[-ww,]

saveRDS(merge.snp.table, file= "../../../Big_data/SNPpool_wFounders.RDS")


u_pool <- anti_join(pool.snp, found.snp, by = join_by(CHROM, POS))
saveRDS(u_pool, file= "../../../Big_data/SNPs_in_FF_notin_Founders.RDS")

f_pool <- anti_join(found.snp, pool.snp, by = join_by(CHROM, POS))
saveRDS(u_pool, file= "../../../Big_data/SNPs_in_Founders_notin_FF.RDS")

```

Set up commands for inference

```{r}
AllArms <- c("X","2L","2R","3L","3R")
pools <- c("CON1","CON2","CON3","CON4","FP1","FP2","FP3","FP4")

combs <- crossing(AllArms, pools)

cat("", file="Cmd_list_HapInf.txt")

for(ii in 1:nrow(combs))
{
  cmd <- paste("Rscript Hap_Inference.R ",
               combs$AllArms[ii],
               " ",
               combs$pools[ii],
               " >temp",ii,".txt",
               " 2>error",ii,".err &", sep="")
  
  cat(cmd, "\n", file="Cmd_list_HapInf.txt", append = TRUE)
}

```

For genome scan for haplotypes, run the following:

```{txt}
Rscript GenomeScan_Haplotypes.R 2L >temp1.txt 2>error1.err &
  
Rscript GenomeScan_Haplotypes.R 2R >temp2.txt 2>error2.err &
  
Rscript GenomeScan_Haplotypes.R 3L >temp3.txt 2>error3.err &

Rscript GenomeScan_Haplotypes.R 3R >temp4.txt 2>error4.err &
  
Rscript GenomeScan_Haplotypes.R X >temp5.txt 2>error5.err &
```
